notes:
### 新功能

- 全屏时隐藏浮窗：放幻灯片、看全屏视频、浏览器全屏时，记忆卡片、待办便签、时区时钟、临时文本浮窗会先从那块屏上藏起来，退出全屏自动回来；投影仪上放映时，笔记本屏幕上的浮窗照常显示。可以在「设置 → 外观」里关掉，或只选其中几种。聚合搜索、超级剪贴板、截图、录屏、贴图不受影响，全屏时照常能用。

### 修复

- 聚合搜索框（以及超级剪贴板）偶尔点外面、按 Esc 都关不掉的问题。
- 局域网互传页里，本机地址和收件目录两行文字后面多出的一条底色。

### 改进

- 某一页出错时不再整个窗口变空白：只在这一页显示出错原因和「重试」，别的页面照常使用；悬浮窗出错时也能直接关掉。
- 检查更新改为先查 Gitee、再查 GitHub。

### New

- Hide floating windows in full screen: during a slideshow, full-screen video or full-screen browser, the memory card, todo sticky note, time zone clock and temp text window step aside on that screen and come back when full screen ends; when presenting on a projector, the floating windows on your laptop screen stay. Turn it off or pick which ones in Settings → Appearance. Search, Super Clipboard, screenshots, recording and pinned images are not affected and keep working in full screen.

### Fixes

- Search (and Super Clipboard) could occasionally get stuck open, ignoring clicks outside and Esc.
- On the LAN Transfer page, the local address and inbox folder lines had a stray background band.

### Improvements

- An error on one page no longer blanks the whole window: only that page shows the error and a Retry button, and the other pages keep working; a floating window that hits an error can be closed directly.
- Update checks now go to Gitee first, then GitHub.
